02Data we collect

  • Account: first name, last name, email address and password (stored only in encrypted form, unreadable even to us).
  • Member profile: phone and city (optional), membership status and sign-up date.
  • Consent: date and time at which you accepted the statutes and this policy.
  • Security: IP address and browser type linked to your sign-in sessions and your sign-up.

We collect no sensitive data and buy no data from third parties.

03How we use it

  • Manage your membership and your member area.
  • Sign you in securely and protect accounts against abuse.
  • Send you the necessary emails: address confirmation, forgotten password, club information.

Your data is never sold or used for advertising.

04Hosting and recipients

Data is stored in Switzerland by Infomaniak Network SA, which hosts the website, the database and the email service. Only committee members in charge of administration can access it. No data is transferred abroad.

05Retention

  • Member data: for the duration of the membership, then [2 ans] at most.
  • Sign-in sessions: 7 days after the last activity.
  • Links sent by email: 24 hours for address confirmation, 1 hour for passwords.

06Cookies and local storage

The website uses a single, essential cookie: the one that keeps you signed in. Your browser also remembers your theme (light or dark) and the announcements you closed.

No analytics, no advertising, no third-party cookies. Fonts are served by the website itself.

07Security

Connections are encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are stored hashed and links sent by email expire quickly.

08Your rights

You can ask at any time to access, correct, export or delete your data, or withdraw your consent.

Write to us at contact@psg-zurich.ch: we reply within 30 days. You can also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC): edoeb.admin.ch

09Changes

This policy may change. The update date appears at the top of the page; members are notified by email of any significant change.
